summary: R303 is a narrow Paper 15 printed-p.140 source-layout/source-footnote repair on top of R302. It restores the Hilbert module-basis congruence to the source's inline placement after the colon, using source-style `\modu{(f_1,\ldots,f_k)}` notation rather than a separate displayed `\pmod` formula. It also moves source footnote marker `1)` onto the displayed final term `Af_\nu` by changing the display to `Af_\nu\srcfnmark{1)}` and keeping the footnote text as `\srcfntext{1)}{...}`. The cumulative German TeX/PDF builds with XeLaTeX and remains 474 pages.
global_caveat: Targeted two-locus Paper 15 support only. The staged page image is a 650dpi render from GDZ material whose native quality is about 400ppi; the 1000-equivalent crop is only a readability aid. This is not Paper 15 certification, Noether closure, multilingual synchronization, whole-corpus source closure, or critical-edition material.
